I read the updated Outline (revision 10) and it matches my results on the `shap` default. One block is out of date, and I've posted the correction in `story-repo`#7.

- **Already right:** the split into default budget, headline setting `l1_reg=False`, and library default call `num_features(10)` is in the Outline. Its library-default numbers (strict share 0.68–0.93 at d ≥ 16, and 0.38 / 0.25 at d=279) and its d=279 sentence match my tables.
- **Out of date:** the Outline's floor-b-by-background lines still quote the earlier delivery (18 cells, medians 0.46 / 0.61 / 0.75 / 0.77, and "24 of 24 rows"). The current delivery has all 20 cells, with medians 0.45 / 0.59 / 0.75 / 0.77. The paper's `results.tex` already carries the current numbers, so only the Outline needs refreshing. Against `shap_kernel` the paired difference is negative in all 32 default-budget rows and all 80 largest-sampled rows. Against `kernel_paired` the sign is mixed (positive in 18 of 32 default-budget rows).

I have no code or results to change, so nothing was pushed.
